turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have until then. Owen found out about his zero from his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start by telling me who decided that and on what basis.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Save it, Hale. What do you actually have on Owen's essay, other than a piece of software?
I really respect how much you care.
Then why are we here, Hale? Show me a document, or I'm going upstairs to the principal when we're done.
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
We're not on the same team; you entered a zero before anyone called me, and your own procedure 4.2 says you contact the parent first. I'm writing down that you still haven't shown me anything.
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
Compliments aren't evidence, Hale. Withdraw the zero, or show me what you've got.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and that nothing is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed in her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and she still intends to go to the principal; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because no evidence was put on the table.
What moved her: Nothing, because every turn offered praise and none offered something she could check.
What cost ground: You answered each of her questions about who decided and what you had with another compliment, which read to her as managing her and made her trust you less.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence came nowhere near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it went in before you called home, then show her something dated from Owen's own process or another sample of his work that she can read for herself, as procedure 4.3 describes.
